body_lead: Nara Lokesh, Andhra Pradesh’s Minister for Education, IT, and Electronics, emphasized the need for reskilling to address the transformative impact of Artificial Intelligence (AI) on global economies and labor markets. Speaking at a roundtable discussion on "The Transformative Impact of AI on Global Economies & Labour Markets" held at the Alpen Gold Hotel in Davos, Lokesh highlighted the increasing demand for roles such as data scientists, AI trainers, and ethical AI specialists.
